record.paper_title: On the combinatorics of tableaux -- A notebook of open problems
record.original_question: Consider the treek-SYTof standard Young tableaux with at mostkrows, with the tree structure generated by containment. What are its automorphisms, when it is considered an unlabeled tree?

evidence.quote: [Dale R. Worley] Consider the treek-SY Tof standard Young tableaux with at mostkrows, with the tree structure generated by containment. What are its automorphisms, when it is considered an unlabeled tree?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k\geq 1$ be a fixed integer. A standard Young tableau (SYT) of size $n$ with at most $k$ rows is a filling of the cells of a Young diagram $\lambda \vdash n$, with $\lambda$ having at most $k$ rows, by the integers $1,2,\dots,n$ such that entries strictly increase along rows (left to right) and down columns. Define the rooted tree $T_k$-SYT as follows:

- The vertex set is the set of all standard Young tableaux with at most $k$ rows (including the empty tableau of size $0$).
- The empty tableau is the root.
- For each SYT $T$ of size $n\geq 1$, its parent in the tree is the SYT of size $n-1$ obtained by deleting the cell containing the entry $n$ from $T$ (this cell is necessarily a corner cell, and the resulting tableau still has at most $k$ rows).

Regard $T_k$-SYT as an unlabeled rooted tree (i.e., forget the SYT labels of the vertices and remember only the abstract rooted tree structure given by the parent–child relation).

Determine the automorphism group $\operatorname{Aut}(T_k\text{-SYT})$ of this unlabeled rooted tree, for every integer $k\geq 1$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a recent (2025) compilation of open problems on the combinatorics of tableaux, attributed to Dale R. Worley. No published resolution determining the automorphism group of the unlabeled tree of bounded-row standard Young tableaux under containment was located.
